spec: §15 suite F (frame-descriptor live ranges); §9.4: shared frames only with disjoint live ranges (suite F)
derivation: A certificate whose frame descriptor shares one scratch bundle between two callees with overlapping live ranges must be rejected: the shared wires would be live in both at once. No reference-CLI command validates certificate frame descriptors today (certificate checking is library/staged-checker surface).
